title: Telemetry admin dashboard hydration
summary: PR-19..27 shipped telemetryAggregators.ts (audit items #42, #70, #71) and a presentational admin page at client/src/pages/admin/telemetry.tsx but never the hydration container. H6 wires the existing aggregators to a server endpoint and the page to a fetch hook. Closes the last PR-19..27 follow-up row.

in: client/src/lib/telemetryClient.ts (new, ~80 LoC) — fetch hook (uses React Query if already in deps; otherwise plain useEffect + AbortController)
client/src/pages/admin/telemetry.tsx — replace the presentational stub with a useTelemetry()-driven view
server/lib/telemetry.ts — add a query-side function `queryTelemetry(metric, windowDays)` that reads from the existing telemetry log + applies the aggregators
Targeted vitest: server endpoint contract; client hook handles loading/error states
out: Real-time updates / WebSocket push (deferred — daily refresh is enough for admin telemetry)

acceptance_criteria: Endpoint returns validatorFirings / regenerationHeatmap / tokenCostRollup shapes that match the existing aggregators' output.
Page hydrates within 500ms on cached data; shows skeleton during cold fetch.
Admin sees per-validator firing counts (top 10), per-topic regen heat-map, per-school token cost rollup for the past 30 days.
Errors surface as a banner with retry button; page never crashes.
related: PR-22 / audit #78 — telemetry log; PR-27 / audits #42, #70, #71 — aggregators; PR-9 / audit #76 — PII redaction
